text:
Nina P.: Quick sync — we have a bunch of small reports where resumed iterators replay items. Need a single cross-language decision on retry + paging ownership.

Rob C.: Yup. Root cause: TS treated resume_token as next-offset, Go treated as last-committed boundary. Pick one model.

Ethan M.: I'm in favor of server-authoritative opaque tokens. SDKs treat token as memo checkpoint. Avoid numeric semantics.

Priya S.: For ergonomics: default iterator auto-retries for transient transport errors, but it must not yield duplicates. We can dedupe on token boundaries after yield + persist.

Nina P.: Proposal summary: 1) resume_token = opaque server checkpoint 2) iterator auto-retries enabled by default (configurable opt-out) 3) iterator dedupes pages using last_seen_token 4) provide explicit checkpoint()/cursor API for manual control.

Rob C.: Batching nuance: server must only hand out token once page commit is durable. If server can't guarantee that, offer translate_token API to reconcile rotated tokens.

Ethan M.: Transport boundary: keep transports minimal — define adapter: send(req) => response | stream. SDK layer owns retry/backoff/paging so transports can be swapped.

Priya S.: Sketches:
```ts
const it = client.listThings({ pageSize: 200 });
for await (const page of it) {
  // page.items deduped across resumes
}
await it.checkpoint();
```
```py
it = client.list_things(page_size=200)
for page in it:
    # deduped
it.checkpoint()
```
Go: Pager with ResumeToken() method for persistence.

Nina P.: Edge-case: network dies after server returns token but before client persists: server should reissue same token for same checkpoint during resume window. If short-lived tokens are unavoidable, server exposes translate_token(old)->current.

Rob C.: Tests: create cross-lang fault-injection harness: drop after payload, before token persist, mid-page. Verify no duplicates and resume reaches server commit.

Ethan M.: Retry defaults: enabled, maxAttempts=4, baseDelay=60ms, jitter, factor=2. Expose RetryPolicy object for advanced tuning. Go opts: slightly more aggressive for low-latency apps.

Priya S.: Observability: iterator should emit telemetry events (page.start, page.succeed(token), page.retry(reason), page.dedupe(token)). Helps debug dup reports.

ci-bot: created rfc/sdk-iterator-retry-paging-draft-2026

Nina P.: Action items: Priya — draft py/ts/go shapes by Thu. Rob — sync with server on token durability/translate API. Ethan — PR for transport adapter and SDK retry hooks. I'll wire up fuzz tests and follow up. Thanks all! :rocket:
